verdict: Leg 4, re-armed and scoped to the key change a42db73c..dd4ed7b5 (mmnto-ai/totem#2879): 0 BLOCKING, 5 MATERIAL, 5 MINOR, no wrong-allow. The code path converged for the class it was armed on: the suite premise matched the live API on both incident heads to the digit (two suites under one workflow id); only the latest attempt is listed in the rollup while filter=all shows both attempts in one suite; matrix jobs share a suite with distinct names; 25 main heads carry no same-suite collision; CheckSuite.databaseId and Workflow.databaseId are nullable, non-Actions suites carry an id, github-actions is the real slug on 352 of 352 rows; the three fixtures kill their mutants at the spec's strength; the reshape changed nothing but checkSuite across all 71 pre-existing fixtures; the captures unchanged; receipts recomputed. What did not converge was the claim boundary and coverage: r4-F1 the changeset quoted the pre-fold fragment and omitted the new arms (folded: rewritten with the shipped fragment and every fail-closed arm); r4-F2 the null-suite-id arm and the Actions-without-workflow-id arm were unreachable from the corpus (folded: two fixtures); r4-F3 two independent runs of one workflow on one head collapse to the latest, a live class the narration talked past (folded: RULED in the spec and the collapse docblock — the latest run of a workflow wins, as the merge box takes it — and disclosed as superseded); r4-F4 a non-Actions app's same-named pair, always one suite, now goes unevaluable with a reason text naming a workflow run (folded: the reason names two runs of one app too; a fixture; the class named in the spec); r4-F5 the reusable-workflow residual closes on a receipt — workflowRun.workflow is the CALLER and callee job names are prefixed (folded: the spec closes it); r4-F6 the collapse docblock and SupersededRun.producer stated the pre-fold arms (folded); r4-F7 the producer-null reason named only the app field (folded: names the workflow id of an Actions run too); r4-F8 the fallback ordering keyed a non-Actions app with a workflow id where the JSDoc said slug alone (folded: the JSDoc says finer, never coarser); r4-F9 whether two same-named jobs of one run reach the rollup at all is unproven (folded as disclosure in the fixture role and the spec: the arm is defensive and fail-closed); r4-F10 'replaces its check run in place' was literally false (folded: mints a new run in the same suite, the rollup lists only the latest). The leg named its termination condition — fold as prose, docblocks and fixtures without rewiring the key — and the fold is exactly that. Convergence named by the leg and by the seat: no fifth leg.
